'''North New Ayre''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[South New Ayre]] to the south, the [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] to the west, the [[Sahare Gulf]] and [[Uscea Sea]] to the north, and the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|4,444,248|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 14th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 204,346,477 as of 1765, making it also the 12th largest sub-continent by population.
